title: Gate dispensations
intro: Inherited approvals (Modular) and waivers (End-to-End). A dispensation never creates a gate decision and never approves a gate.
businessApproval: accepting, rejecting and revoking a dispensation are decided in person by the waived gate's configured approver. The person who recorded it can never decide it.

decide.recorderCannot: Recorded by you: another approver decides.
decide.title: Decide: {{kind}} of {{gate}}

description.inherited_approval: Accepting records that an approval granted before this product was used stands for the sequencing rules. It counts only while its evidence is verified.
description.waiver: Accepting unblocks the launch sequencing for this gate only, until the expiry date. It does not approve the gate.

decide.unverifiedEvidence: The evidence of this inherited approval is not verified: it will not count until it is.

revoke.title: Revoke the dispensation of {{gate}}
revoke.description: A revoked dispensation no longer counts for sequencing. It stays in the history.

list.title: Inherited approvals and waivers
list.intro: Every dispensation is pending until another person holding the gate decision accepts or rejects it.
list.emptyBody: Gates are only passed by their own approval in this product unless a dispensation is recorded and accepted.

record.title: Record a dispensation
record.description: A waiver needs a reason, a scope and an expiry. An inherited approval needs the approving body, the approval date and an evidence item.

kindHint.end_to_end: End-to-End transformation: waivers of G2 or G3 for launch. Inherited approvals apply only to Modular transformations.
kindHint.modular: Modular transformation: inherited approvals of G1-G3 granted before this product was used. Waivers apply only to End-to-End transformations.

record.reasonHint: Why the launch may proceed before this gate is approved.
record.scopeHint: The whole transformation, or one initiative only.
record.evidenceHint: The record of the earlier approval. It counts only once verified; a filename alone never counts.
record.pendingNote: It stays pending until another person decides it.

problem.dispensation__approved_on_future: The approval date cannot be in the future.
problem.dispensation__decider_is_recorder: Separation of duties: the person who recorded this dispensation cannot decide it.
problem.dispensation__evidence_not_verified: The evidence is not verified: the inherited approval cannot be accepted yet.
problem.dispensation__gate_approved: This gate is already approved; nothing to dispense.
problem.dispensation__inherited_requires_modular: An inherited approval can be recorded only for a Modular transformation.
problem.dispensation__inherited_scope: An inherited approval covers the whole transformation, not one initiative.
problem.dispensation__inherited_incomplete: An inherited approval needs the approving body, the approval date and an evidence item.
problem.dispensation__not_pending: Only a pending dispensation can be accepted or rejected.
problem.dispensation__not_revocable: Only an accepted dispensation can be revoked.
problem.dispensation__on_behalf_not_supported: A dispensation is decided by the approver in person; deciding on someone's behalf is not available. Nothing was recorded.
problem.dispensation__waiver_gate: A waiver applies only to the launch sequencing of G2 or G3; G1 is never waived.
problem.dispensation__waiver_requires_end_to_end: A waiver applies to the End-to-End launch sequencing; a Modular transformation is not held to it.
problem.dispensation__waiver_shape: A waiver carries no approving body, approval date or evidence.
problem.dispensation__waiver_incomplete: A waiver needs a reason and an expiry date.
problem.gate__not_approver: Only the configured approver of this gate can decide its dispensations.
